In this talk, we’ll explore why traditional development environments are becoming a bottleneck and what it takes to build infrastructure designed for autonomous agents. Each system enforces access its own way, and none of them knows which agent is acting for which person. As a result, teams either give agents over-privileged service accounts or the agents can’t reach the data they need. Using Apache Gravitino as the example, the talk covers how a federated metadata catalog becomes the control point for agent data access.
